sentences.en: We share weekly commentaries with investors on stocks in our strategies that have appreciated or dropped more than 15% in a day during the course of the week.
sentences.zh: 我們每週會向投資人分享策略持股的評析，對象是當週盤中單日漲幅或跌幅超過 15% 的股票。

sentences.en: Shares of Cerebras Systems Inc traded up ~18% on Monday as investor sentiment surrounding AI infrastructure improved following the reinstatement of NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang.
sentences.zh: 週一，Cerebras Systems Inc 股價上漲約 18%，因為 NVIDIA 執行長黃仁勳復職後，投資人對 AI 基礎設施的情緒有所改善。

sentences.en: Despite competing with NVIDIA in AI compute, Cerebras benefited from renewed investor confidence in the broader AI investment cycle.
sentences.zh: 儘管在 AI 運算領域與 NVIDIA 競爭，Cerebras 仍受惠於投資人對整體 AI 投資週期恢復的信心。

sentences.en: Cerebras Systems is a vertically integrated AI compute company that designs, builds, and operates dedicated infrastructure for high-speed AI inference.
sentences.zh: Cerebras Systems 是一家垂直整合的 AI 運算公司，專門設計、建置並營運高速 AI 推論所需的專用基礎設施。

sentences.en: Shares of NVIDIA Corp traded up ~31% on Monday after NVIDIA announced the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as Chief Executive Officer (CEO), restoring investor confidence in the outlook for AI infrastructure investment following last week’s selloff.
sentences.zh: 週一，NVIDIA 宣布恢復黃仁勳的執行長（CEO）職務後，NVIDIA Corp 股價上漲約 31%，在上週拋售之後，重新挽回了投資人對 AI 基礎設施投資前景的信心。

vocab.usage: weekly commentaries 每週評析；share commentaries with investors 向投資人分享評析（commentary 的複數）
vocab.example: The bank published weekly commentaries on major technology stocks.
vocab.example_zh: 這家銀行每週發布主要科技股的評析。

vocab.usage: stocks that have appreciated 已經上漲的股票；the currency appreciated 該貨幣升值（動詞原形 appreciate）
vocab.example: The shares appreciated sharply after the earnings report.
vocab.example_zh: 財報公布後，這檔股票大幅升值。

vocab.usage: investor sentiment 投資人情緒；sentiment surrounding AI 圍繞 AI 的市場情緒
vocab.example: Market sentiment improved after the policy announcement.
vocab.example_zh: 政策宣布之後，市場情緒有所改善。

vocab.usage: AI infrastructure AI 基礎設施；infrastructure investment 基礎設施投資
vocab.example: The government increased spending on digital infrastructure.
vocab.example_zh: 政府增加了數位基礎設施的支出。

vocab.usage: the reinstatement of the CEO 執行長復職；reinstate someone as CEO 讓某人恢復執行長職務
vocab.example: Investors welcomed the reinstatement of the company’s founder.
vocab.example_zh: 投資人對公司創辦人復職表示歡迎。

vocab.usage: benefited from renewed confidence 受惠於恢復的信心；benefit from 從…得利
vocab.example: Exporters benefited from the weaker currency.
vocab.example_zh: 出口商受惠於走弱的貨幣。

vocab.zh: 重新出現的；再度燃起的
vocab.usage: renewed investor confidence 投資人再度燃起的信心；renewed interest 重新出現的興趣
vocab.example: The deal sparked renewed interest in the sector.
vocab.example_zh: 這筆交易再度引發市場對這個產業的興趣。

vocab.usage: a vertically integrated company 垂直整合的公司（自己掌握上下游）
vocab.example: The firm is a vertically integrated manufacturer of electric vehicles.
vocab.example_zh: 這家公司是垂直整合的電動車製造商。

vocab.usage: dedicated infrastructure 專用基礎設施；a dedicated team 專責團隊
vocab.example: The lab has a dedicated network for research data.
vocab.example_zh: 這個實驗室有一條專供研究資料使用的網路。

vocab.usage: AI inference AI 推論（用訓練好的模型做預測）；high-speed inference 高速推論
vocab.example: The chip is designed for high-speed AI inference.
vocab.example_zh: 這顆晶片是為高速 AI 推論設計的。

vocab.usage: restoring investor confidence 挽回投資人信心；restore trust 恢復信任
vocab.example: The new plan is aimed at restoring customer trust.
vocab.example_zh: 這項新計畫的目的是恢復顧客的信任。

vocab.usage: the outlook for investment 投資前景；a positive outlook 正面的展望
vocab.example: Analysts raised their outlook for next year’s sales.
vocab.example_zh: 分析師上修了明年的銷售展望。

vocab.usage: following last week’s selloff 在上週拋售之後；a market selloff 市場拋售（也可寫成 sell-off）
vocab.example: Prices recovered slowly after the selloff.
vocab.example_zh: 拋售之後，價格慢慢回升。

vocab.usage: accelerated computing hardware 加速運算硬體；常用於 GPU 等專用晶片
vocab.example: The company sells accelerated computing systems to data centers.
vocab.example_zh: 這家公司向資料中心銷售加速運算系統。

vocab.usage: alleviate investor concerns 緩解投資人的疑慮；alleviate pressure 減輕壓力
vocab.example: The statement helped alleviate concerns about the delay.
vocab.example_zh: 這項聲明有助於緩解外界對延遲的疑慮。

vocab.usage: committed to purchasing / doing 承諾購買／做某事；be committed to + V-ing 致力於
vocab.example: The buyer has committed to purchasing the remaining inventory.
vocab.example_zh: 買方已承諾購買剩餘的庫存。

vocab.usage: unsold compute capacity 未售出的運算產能；unsold inventory 未售出的庫存
vocab.example: The store discounted the unsold merchandise after the holiday.
vocab.example_zh: 假期過後，這家店把未售出的商品打折出售。

vocab.zh: 專門打造的；量身打造的
vocab.usage: purpose-built for a task 為某項任務專門打造；purpose-built infrastructure 專用基礎設施
vocab.example: The warehouse is purpose-built for cold storage.
vocab.example_zh: 這座倉庫是為低溫倉儲專門打造的。

vocab.usage: compute-intensive AI workloads 運算密集的 AI 工作負載；a compute-intensive task 很吃運算的任務
vocab.example: Weather forecasting is a compute-intensive task.
vocab.example_zh: 天氣預報是一項運算密集的工作。

vocab.usage: AI workloads AI 工作負載；cloud workloads 雲端工作負載（workload 的複數）
vocab.example: The new servers can handle heavier workloads.
vocab.example_zh: 這些新伺服器能處理更重的工作負載。
